Nitish Setu : ganga par 'nitish setu' ka nam, bihar ki siyasat men macha ghamasan! | CM Samrat | Bihar News
Bihar ke buniyadi dhanche ke vikas men ek naya aur svarnim adhyay jurne ja raha hai...patna ke kachchi dargah ko sidhe vaishali ke bidupur se jorne vale is vishal chhah-len pul ka nam ab purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke nam par ‘nitish setu’ rakhne ka bara phaisla liya gaya hai... iski ghoshna khud mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne soshal midiya ke jarie ki...
Bihar aur jharkhand ke taza khabron ke lie dekhte rahie News18 Bihar/Jharkhand
